scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -n backend,frontend,bot -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "node scripts/wait-for-backend.mjs && npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @language-turtle/shared && npm run typecheck -w language-turtle-backend && npm run typecheck -w language-turtle-frontend && npm run typecheck -w language-turtle-bot
